questions.stem: A 55-year-old male presented to the clinic for a routine check-up last week. He has no significant past medical history, but Automated Office Blood Pressure (AoBP) monitoring showed blood pressure readings of 142/94 mmHg, 138/86 mmHg, and 138/90 mmHg. Ambulatory blood pressure monitoring was advised; the average 24-hour blood pressure is 138/86 mmHg. According to the ACC/AHA hypertension classification, what category does his blood pressure fall into?
